title: Roveia flying founder quotes
description: Founder quotes on white cards with 24px corners, a soft shadow and a faint warm or blue corner tint: blue quote mark, quote, attribution and a small 16:9 video. On desktop a big centred two-line heading (second line blue) is pinned while the cards fly across the screen one after another from right to left, tilting from 10° to −10°. Phones stack the cards.
notes: desktop: 680svh tall (pinned for ≈5.8 windows); phones: content height
without scroll-driven animations (or with reduced motion) the cards sit in a three-column grid
